digest.component_or_area: host updater script and runtime state management
propositions: The host updater script uses unlocked pipx VCS resolution, which bypasses the committed uv.lock and Click 8.4.2 security override.

The updater must replace pipx VCS installation with exact-SHA versioned checkout followed by uv sync --locked with runtime and operator extras (mcp, reviewbot, ui, agents, eval, tracing, grounding, grounding-t2) and --no-dev flag.
Sync or smoke-test failures must be logged, exit nonzero, and leave the current release unchanged.
Published releases must be retained only after success; rejected candidates and superseded releases must be cleaned up.
The updater must atomically manage symlinks for rebar, rebar-mcp, and last-good.sha through a versioned current directory.
An immediately following launchd run must detect no change and exit 0 without reinstalling.
